alt: Poster: Sensex 81,106.65 (+0.13%), Nifty 50 25,044.65 (+0.23%), Nifty Pharma +1.6% and Nifty IT -1.2% on 9 Nov 2026
text:
Nifty held above 25,000 on Monday, but the sector picture was split: pharma gained while IT fell.

• Sensex closed at 81,106.65, up 107.25 points (0.13%); Nifty 50 closed at 25,044.65, up 58.25 points (0.23%), per Kotak Neo and HDFC Sky closing reports.
• Nifty Pharma rose about 1.6% and Nifty IT fell about 1.2%, per Kotak Neo and HDFC Sky.
• Nifty Midcap 100 gained roughly 0.55-0.6% and Nifty Smallcap 100 about 0.1%, per Kotak Neo and HDFC Sky.
• Both reports link the mood to easing crude oil prices; HDFC Sky also notes NSE breadth was negative, with 2,316 stocks declining against 1,922 advancing.

Our view: modest index gains alongside weak breadth and diverging sectors suggest participation is still selective. After a long run higher, a quiet session says little about what comes next, and crude and geopolitical headlines can change sentiment quickly. This is an interpretation, not a prediction or advice.

For practitioners: when the index edges up but more stocks decline than advance, which breadth indicators do you rely on to judge the quality of the move?
